display_title: Mr. I, an Office Worker Who Ends Up Getting Erotic Somehow
description:
What if an ordinary office worker suddenly becomes the main character of an erotic manga!? Ian, an ordinary office worker who has been single for a long time and has voluntarily become a nerd, suddenly starts getting involved in all kinds of lewd(?) incidents and accidents, and his coworker Aaron, who has always been displeased with him, and his always smiling, kind junior Noah, start feeling strangely stimulated by Ian's meaningless actions... 

The comical, erotic, and romantic story of an ordinary office worker trapped in the world of an erotic manga and the two men surrounding him begins now.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*Note: Includes 11 side story chapters.*
